text:
elaine: FYI - Enterprise POC (Healthcare customer) requires NO outbound telemetry during the air-gapped trial. also asking for a clear upgrade cadence and any SLA credits if we block on their maintenance windows.
raj: ok noted. do we have a documented opt-out for telemetry in the offline bundle? last time we had to bake a flag into the image.
maria: we can support opt-out but need to capture a couple things: 1) what health signals they allow (local metrics only?), 2) audit log export options (they usually want S3-style export via usb transfer), and 3) whether they need signing for offline bundles.
elaine: they want no network egress at all. local metrics only, and audit logs must be writable to a mounted volume. also they asked: can we provide a signed offline bundle that’s incrementally patchable (delta updates) vs full reimage?
raj: delta bundles are possible but shipping deltas for quantized model weights + runtime patches is tricky. we can do signed chunked deltas but it requires an additional signing step and validation in the operator.
chris-ops: from ops side — rolling upgrades in sealed envs need a maintenance window. typical SLA: we can commit to 99% availability outside agreed maintenance windows. for airgapped POC, we can offer a 2-hour patch window per month; if customer demands stricter cadence, we need commercial exception.
maria: security note — if telemetry is off, we lose remote crash reports and perf traces. we should surface that as a risk to the customer. suggest adding an "opt-in debug" process: customer can enable short-lived debug artifacts and transfer them out-of-band for triage.
raj: config snippet we can include in offline operator to toggle telemetry:
```
redwood:
  telemetry:
    enabled: false  # default for sealed bundles
  audit:
    export_path: /mnt/audit
  signing:
    required: true
```
elaine: makes sense. also pricing ask: they want POC credits if we extend the POC beyond 60 days because they need extra validation cycles. what's standard?
raj: typical deal: we offer 60 days free credits, then a reduced POC rate for next 30 days (50% list). for enterprise we can do custom, but need approval from sales lead.
chris-ops: and note — delta bundle engineering adds ~2-3 engineer-days to package and test per release. we should price that as a one-time packaging fee unless they're on annual dedicated plan.
maria: regarding cert rotation in offline envs: we need a clear manual rotation procedure and scripts that run locally. include a runbook in the bundle. highlight requirement for secure key custody (HSM/KMS offline workflows); if they want automatic rotation we can't do that without egress.
elaine: I'll send this back to the customer today. can someone draft a short bullet list for the SOW items: telemetry opt-out, signed delta bundles (optional), maintenance window + SLA carveout, POC credit terms, cert rotation runbook, audit export path.
raj: on it, will DM a SOW bullets draft.
maria: will add security caveats and the debug workflow.
chris-ops: will add estimated packaging fee and the operation steps.
deploy-bot: Deployment artifact created: bundle-v2-airgap-signed.tar.gz (sha256: abc123...)
elaine: thanks — will update customer. :thumbsup:
